FILE: public/repo.html
================================================
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>NTI-1 Repo Transparency</title>
<style>
body{font-family:system-ui;background:#0a0a0a;color:#eee;padding:2rem;max-width:900px;margin:auto;line-height:1.6}
h1,h2{color:#fff}
code,pre{background:#111;padding:.2rem .5rem;border-radius:5px;color:#4ade80;font-family:ui-monospace,monospace}
pre{padding:1rem;overflow-x:auto;border:1px solid #222}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin:1rem 0}
th,td{text-align:left;padding:.6rem;border-bottom:1px solid #222}
th{color:#888;font-weight:500;font-size:.85rem}
a{color:#22d3ee}
#output{margin-top:1rem}
.muted{color:#888}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<h1>Repo Transparency Page</h1>
<p class="muted">Look up the NTI-1 verification history of any repo.</p>


<form id="lookup" onsubmit="return false">
<input id="repo" placeholder="owner/repo" style="padding:.6rem;background:#111;color:#eee;border:1px solid #333;border-radius:6px;width:60%">
<button style="padding:.6rem 1rem;background:#4ade80;color:#000;border:0;border-radius:6px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer" onclick="loadRepo()">Look up</button>
</form>


<div id="output"></div>


<script>
function esc(s){return String(s ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));}
async function loadRepo(){
  const repo = document.getElementById('repo').value.trim();
  const out = document.getElementById('output');
  if (!repo.includes('/')) { out.innerHTML = '<p style="color:#ef4444">Use owner/repo format</p>'; return; }
  out.innerHTML = '<p class="muted">Loading…</p>';
  try {
    const r = await fetch('/api/certificate?repo=' + encodeURIComponent(repo));
    const data = await r.json();
    if (!data.latest) { out.innerHTML = '<p>No NTI-1 certificate indexed for this repo yet.</p>'; return; }
    let html = '<h2>Latest verified certificate</h2>';
    html += '<table><tr><th>Field</th><th>Value</th></tr>';
    const fields = ['repo','score','tier','commit_sha','timestamp','cert_hash','signature_verified'];
    for (const f of fields) {
      if (data.latest[f] !== undefined) html += '<tr><td>' + esc(f) + '</td><td><code>' + esc(data.latest[f]) + '</code></td></tr>';
    }
    html += '</table>';
    html += '<h2>History (' + data.history_count + ' entries)</h2>';
    html += '<table><tr><th>Timestamp</th><th>Score</th><th>Tier</th><th>Commit</th></tr>';
    for (const h of (data.history||[]).slice().reverse().slice(0,25)) {
      html += '<tr><td>' + esc(h.timestamp) + '</td><td>' + esc(h.score) + '</td><td>' + esc(h.tier||'') + '</td><td><code>' + esc((h.commit_sha||'').slice(0,8)) + '</code></td></tr>';
    }
    html += '</table>';
    html += '<h2>Verify offline</h2><pre>pip install nti-scanner\nnti-scanner verify ./nti-certificate.json</pre>';
    out.innerHTML = html;
  } catch (e) { out.innerHTML = '<p style="color:#ef4444">Lookup failed.</p>'; }
}
</script>
</body>
</html>

FILE: .github/workflows/publish.yml
================================================
name: Publish to PyPI

on:
  release:
    types: [published]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build-and-publish:
    name: Build and publish to PyPI
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      id-token: write
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - name: Install build tools
        run: pip install build
      - name: Build package
        run: python -m build
      - name: Publish package to PyPI
        uses: pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish@release/v1

FILE: .github/workflows/test.yml
================================================
name: Test Suite

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install pytest pytest-asyncio httpx redis pyjwt cryptography
          pip install ube-foundation || echo "ube-foundation optional"
          if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip install -r requirements.txt; fi

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: pytest tests/unit -v

      - name: Run contract tests
        run: pytest tests/contract -v

      - name: Run integration tests
        run: pytest tests/integration -v

      - name: Run failure tests
        run: pytest tests/failure -v

      - name: Run security tests
        run: pytest tests/security -v

      - name: Run regression tests
        run: pytest tests/regression -v

      - name: Run load tests
        run: pytest tests/load -v

      - name: Full suite with coverage
        run: |
          pip install pytest-cov
          pytest tests/ --cov=lib --cov=api --cov=api_handlers --cov-report=term-missing || true

FILE: .github/workflows/validate.yml
================================================
name: Validate Badge System

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Verify Python syntax (all files)
        run: |
          python -m compileall api api_handlers lib
          echo "All Python files compile successfully"
      - name: Verify required files present
        run: |
          test -f action.yml
          test -f vercel.json
          test -f requirements.txt
          test -f README.md
          test -f LICENSE
          test -f docs/NTI-CERT-SPEC.md
          test -f public/index.html
          test -f public/repo.html
          test -f api/index.py
          test -f api_handlers/badge.py
          test -f api_handlers/verify.py
          test -f api_handlers/registry.py
          test -f api_handlers/leaderboard.py
          test -f api_handlers/certificate.py
          test -f api_handlers/transparency.py
          test -f api_handlers/org.py
          test -f api_handlers/federation.py
          test -f lib/routes.py
          test -f lib/oidc.py
          test -f lib/store.py
          test -f lib/crypto.py
          test -f lib/certificate.py
          test -f lib/drift.py
          test -f lib/tiers.py
          test -f lib/spec.py
          echo "All required files present"
      - name: Validate vercel.json is valid JSON
        run: python -c "import json; json.load(open('vercel.json'))"
      - name: Validate action.yml structure
        run: |
          python -c "
          import sys
          try:
              import yaml
          except ImportError:
              print('PyYAML not installed, skipping deep validation')
              sys.exit(0)
          with open('action.yml') as f:
              data = yaml.safe_load(f)
          assert data['name'] == 'NTI Verify'
          assert data['runs']['using'] == 'composite'
          print('action.yml valid')
          "
        continue-on-error: true
